subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Guy de Maupassant and the Twist Ending
description: One-minute skill: Guy de Maupassant and the Twist Ending.

hook.text: Guy de Maupassant mastered the surprise ending so well that an entire generation of writers copied his technique.

buildup.text: In The Necklace, a woman spends ten years repaying a debt for a lost diamond necklace she borrowed for a party.

discovery.text: Maupassant wrote over three hundred short stories in a single decade, an output almost unmatched in history.

twist.text: At the end of The Necklace, the woman discovers the diamonds were fake, and her decade of suffering was pointless.

climax.text: Maupassant influenced O. Henry, Roald Dahl, and every writer who crafts a story around a devastating final reveal.

punchline.text: One fake necklace taught the world about real irony.

quiz.question: What happens at the end of Maupassant's The Necklace?
options: The woman becomes wealthy and buys a real necklace
She discovers the borrowed diamonds were fake, making her sacrifice pointless
The necklace is found and returned to her
